Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Changelog:
v1.8.4.3 — Changes since v1.8.4.1

CRITICAL FIX:
- PartyFinder cross-world party and alliance members are now read from FFXIV's InfoProxyCrossRealm data instead of the local-only party list
- Group synchronization now preserves the last valid member snapshot while cross-world data is temporarily unavailable
- Strict validation no longer removes every player when the cross-world proxy is active but updating

ALLIANCE SUPPORT:
- Full alliance support is always active: one dealer can manage up to 23 players
- Party/alliance chat and group /dice commands route to alliance chat while an alliance is active
- Added Alliance settings, Nearby J configuration, and an Alliance Invite custom-command creator

NEW:
- Added Version 2 Compact view, /skip, Payout command selections, session-only Allow 0 bet, preset creators, stacked preset previews, <dealerHand>, tip buttons, Open Changelog, and Full Debug tracing
- Added live User Statistics with session review and export

CHANGED:
- Preset previews now simulate complete rounds
- Full player names, color-coded aliases, and thousands-separated Bank/Bet inputs
- Reorganized table controls, Commands, Variables, Stats, regex entries, and preset editing

FIXED:
- Removed stale members through strict group validation without destroying transient cross-world state
- Fixed queued actions, round starts, Bank Tell, Bet Change, zero-bet starts, /skip rows, alliance /dice routing, table alignment, settings labels, and Debug player generation
- Expanded diagnostics for group routing and failed actions
